commentary.text: 90+16' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+16' Richarlison (Tottenham) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+14' It's the second caution for Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) and that's the last we'll see of him in this game. There was no other option for Peter Bankes.
90+13' Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90+10' 2 - 1 Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) latches on to a pass and finds himself in a great position inside the box before unleashing a stunning effort into the top of the net.

90+8' 1 - 1 Richarlison (Tottenham) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:1.
90+8' Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
90+7' Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90+5' Substitution. Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) in, Micky van de Ven out.
90+4' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+4' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute Pedro Porro and he is replaced by Emerson Royal (Tottenham).
90+4' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) sends a chip pass into the box, but Wesley Foderingham is quickest to intercept the ball.
90+2' Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd) has tested the patience of referee Peter Bankes and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+1' Tottenham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+1' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
90' The fourth official shows 12 min. of added time.
90' Tottenham take a short corner kick.

90' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Wesley Foderingham is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
89' Richarlison (Tottenham) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
88' Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
87' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
86' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Peter Bankes's book.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) replaces Jayden Bogle.
84' Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wesley Foderingham, who smothers the ball.
83' The corner kick from James Maddison (Tottenham) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
82' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
81' Here comes a substitution. Gustavo Hamer is given a rest as he is replaced by Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd).
80' Pape Matar Sarr comes off the pitch to be replaced by Richarlison (Tottenham).
80' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) replaces Manor Solomon.
80' Substitution. Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) replaces Heung-Min Son.
78' A shot from the edge of the box by Manor Solomon (Tottenham) is close, but lifts narrowly over the bar at the last second.
77' Tottenham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
76' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

73' 0 - 1 That's scrappy, but it's a GOAL! The long throw into the box comically bobbles around until pounced on by Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd), who scuffs the ball into the net from inside the six-yard box. It's now 0:1.
73' Sheffield Utd take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
72' Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
70' James McAtee will be replaced by Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd).
69' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Manor Solomon (Tottenham) for a tough tackle.
68' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
67' James Maddison (Tottenham) was probably a bit loose with his words to Peter Bankes, who decides to show him a yellow.
67' Manor Solomon (Tottenham) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he sends his effort over the crossbar.
66' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
65' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
63' Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) gets booked for the first time in this match.
62' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
62' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
61' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.
60' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
59' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) steps up to send the ball in.
59' The ball is cleared after Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Tottenham.
57' A quickly taken corner by Tottenham.
57' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
56' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) for his blatant foul.
54' James Maddison (Tottenham) works the corner short.
54' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
53' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
53' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Peter Bankes signals.
51' Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
49' Peter Bankes shows the yellow card to Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) for a heavy challenge.
48' Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
48' James Maddison (Tottenham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
47' The referee signals a corner kick to Tottenham.
47' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
46' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
46' Peter Bankes blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+4' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Guglielmo Vicario shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
45+3' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) will take the corner.
45+2' Tottenham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

45+1' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Tottenham manage to earn a corner.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' A yellow-coloured card is received by Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd).
43' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
42' James Maddison (Tottenham) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
42' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
41' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) sees a yellow card from Peter Bankes after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
40' James Maddison (Tottenham) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
38' Manor Solomon does well to cross from a difficult angle and find Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) on the edge of the six-yard box, but his header slips well wide of the right post.
37' Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
35' Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

34' James Maddison (Tottenham) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Wesley Foderingham makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
32' PENALTY APPEAL after James Maddison (Tottenham) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
29' Today's referee Peter Bankes rightly decides to book Chris Basham (Sheffield Utd) for his harsh tackle.
27' Manor Solomon (Tottenham) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Wesley Foderingham is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
25' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham), who has already been caught several times today.

23' Excellent touch by James McAtee (Sheffield Utd)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
21' Manor Solomon (Tottenham) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
21' Good work from Tottenham as they win a corner.
20' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Wesley Foderingham stops the ball from going inside right post.
19' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
19' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the left post is smartly dealt with by Wesley Foderingham.
18' James Maddison (Tottenham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

17' What a save from Wesley Foderingham! Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
15' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking James Maddison (Tottenham), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
14' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Sheffield Utd was in an offside position.
13' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) heads on.
12' Manor Solomon (Tottenham) plays a through ball but overhits it.
9' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
8' Manor Solomon (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
4' A pass by Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
3' Tottenham are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The first half has just begun.
Sheffield Utd will kick-off.
Peter Bankes will officiate today.
